name: Onboarding for Managers
summary: Immerse yourself in a guided, interactive tour of your new workplace before you even set foot inside: ask live questions of Human Resources and IT staff, explore every corner at your own pace, and teleport or manually navigate through each area of the office. Once you’ve familiarized yourself with the space, join your colleagues in a shared metaverse environment where you can collaborate, chat, and start building meaningful connections from Day 1. Along the way, you’ll encounter contextual pop-ups and hands
